errors.session_expired: The CloudCharge login is no longer valid. Log in again under the app settings and the charger comes back on its own.
errors.missing_alias: This device has no alias stored, so charging cannot be started or stopped. Remove it and add it again.
errors.local_disabled: Local current control is not set up. Enable it in the device settings and fill in the charger's IP address and PIN.
errors.stop_forbidden: CloudCharge refuses to stop. Usually this means no charging session is running — check whether the charger reads as available. If a car is plugged in and charging, the session may have started without authorisation because Plug & Charge is on, in which case it is not counted as yours.
errors.current_out_of_range: The charging current must be between __min__ and __max__ A for this installation.
errors.current_not_integer: The charging current must be a whole number of amps.
errors.clu_incomplete_config: Could not read a complete configuration from the charger, so nothing was changed. Try again shortly.
errors.clu_config_changed: The installation settings on the charger have changed since the device was added, so the write was cancelled as a safety measure. Remove the device and add it again if the change was intentional.
errors.clu_ambiguous_connector: The charger has several charge points and the app cannot tell which one belongs to this device.
errors.clu_bad_pin: The charger did not accept the PIN. Check the configurator PIN in the device settings.
errors.clu_unreachable: Cannot reach the charger on your local network. Check the IP address in the device settings.
errors.start_forbidden: CloudCharge refused to start charging. Check that the charger is shared with your account and that the car is plugged in.
errors.eco_read_failed: Could not read the current eco mode configuration from CloudCharge, so nothing was changed. Try again shortly.
errors.clu_refused: The charger refused the request. Try again shortly, and check the configurator PIN if it keeps happening.
errors.clu_write_uncertain: The charger did not answer in time, so it is unclear whether the change was applied. Check the charger before trying again — the app will not repeat the write on its own.

errors.invalid_phone: Enter a valid mobile number, including the country code.
errors.invalid_code: That code was not accepted. Check the digits, or request a new code.
errors.no_login_attempt: No code is pending for this number. Request a new one.
errors.no_phone: Start over and enter your mobile number first.
errors.all_paired: Every charger on this account has already been added to Homey. If you came here to sign in again, that is done — the charger comes back on its own.
